scientific_core.one_sentence: Does a state learned only from continuous background and interictal events retain cross-window history that transfers to seizure susceptibility and seizure-entry organisation after the state is frozen?

hypotheses.H2b_T: persistent state adds held-out seizure-risk information beyond nuisance, event history and current observation
hypotheses.H2b_M: the cross-window persistent-history residual outperforms a same-window memoryless code
hypotheses.H2b_D: the frozen state shows time-scale-matched basin occupancy, directed approach or abrupt seizure-entry geometry out of sample

populations.all_frozen: all checkpoint-available cells with seizure support, without H2b-outcome selection
populations.preexisting_h1_stable_stratum: R1.7B H1 stability fixed before H2b and used only as a named stratum
populations.state_qualified: checkpoints passing Q1-Q6 using interictal-only development data; no seizure outcome may enter this gate

time_axis.gap_policy: reset at every recorded coverage segment

nuisance.sleep_contract: never infer sleep from vigilance; unavailable validated sleep labels remain explicitly unavailable

estimands.T: held-out 30-min log_loss(M2) - log_loss(M1); negative favours persistent-state increment
estimands.M: held-out 30-min log_loss(M4) - log_loss(M3); negative favours residual persistent-history increment
estimands.D: pre-registered lag-response and held-out seizure-entry geometry; not a replacement for T or M

evaluation.initial_k_selection: chosen once by the semi-synthetic assay without inspecting v0.3 real-outcome performance
evaluation.outer_test_rule: each predicted lead seizure is strictly later than every seizure used to fit or select the probe
evaluation.primary_metric: held-out full-grid discrete-time hazard log loss
evaluation.v0_2_bridge_metric: exact onset-minus-lead conditional risk-set log loss; sensitivity only

state_qualification.Q1_noncollapse: decoder-standardised effective rank and variance structure must exceed collapsed/shuffled interictal null
state_qualification.Q2_cross_window_information: persistent must improve held-out interictal future-IED/background prediction over memoryless/current-window-only
state_qualification.Q3_generator_contribution: generator drift and open-loop information must exceed reset/memoryless interictal null; observation correction cannot explain essentially all state motion
state_qualification.Q4_time_constant: decoder-metric tau_z must exceed the current observation window and show identifiable decay within eligible continuous segments; a near-constant or interval-censored estimate is not treated as biological failure
state_qualification.Q5_seed_stability: decoder outputs or decoder-distance geometry must exceed seed-permuted stability null in at least three seeds
state_qualification.Q6_not_only_clock: interictal state increment must remain after validated clock, sleep, recording-day, prior-seizure and segment adjustment
state_qualification.patient_gate: at least three checkpoint seeds pass mandatory Q1-Q5 and Q6 with every validated available nuisance; seizure outcomes are forbidden
state_qualification.unavailable_component_policy: missing optional validated sleep or medication metadata is reported and stratified, not converted into state failure; missing mandatory instrument evidence fails state_qualified but remains in all_frozen

probe_ladder.primary: ridge pooled logistic or discrete-time hazard
probe_ladder.sensitivity: low-degree monotone spline or GAM with degrees of freedom frozen by assay
probe_ladder.oracle_ceiling: development-only nonlinear ceiling; never a primary claim

geometry.fit_population: outer-training clean interictal continuous trajectories only
geometry.heldout_projection: all preictal and ictal evaluation states are out-of-sample projections

gates.A1_before_seizure_probe: state instrument qualification passes for a non-empty predeclared population
gates.A2_before_real_outcome_interpretation: type-I error and power criteria pass
gates.A3_before_geometry_claim: a positive T signal is recovered by an assay with adequate power; all-frozen geometry may still be generated as explicitly non-claim diagnostic
gates.A6_before_ied_ablation: a stable positive T signal and at least one pre-registered M or D component exist

claim_ladder.T_positive_M_negative_D_positive_at_5min: acute preictal encoder, not slow state
claim_ladder.T_positive_M_positive_D_negative: slow contextual state without seizure-time specificity
claim_ladder.ied_ablation_positive: IED learning contributed transferable seizure-relevant state information
claim_ladder.phenotype_bridge_positive: state also predicts ictal recruitment organisation; still not H3 causality

questions: Was the tested state learned without seizure labels and frozen before this analysis?
Does the primary contrast add state to the same nuisance-history-observation design matrix?
Is cross-window memory tested separately from current-window observation filtering?
Are time specificity and geometry evaluated out of sample on the states own interictal time scale?
Are patients and out-of-fold lead seizures, rather than seeds or anchors, the scientific support units?
Would the planned result distinguish transferable representation, persistent state and ictal organisation?
Is any IED-specific or causal wording supported by its own ablation or intervention rather than prediction alone?
drift_audit.failure_action: record SCIENTIFIC_ROUTE_DRIFT and stop only the affected claim branch; do not reinterpret an engineering PASS as scientific support
